Responsibilities: ***Priority will be given to the residents of Moghbazar, Eskaton, and Banglamotor area*** * Receiving and managing inbound and outbound calls. * Providing information related to vehicle to customers and answering queries. * Making follow-up calls to interested customers. * Listening to customer complaints and providing solutions with patience. * Promptly replying to customer messages in the Facebook Page inbox. * Monitoring comments and replying or moderating as necessary. * Filtering out spam and inappropriate comments for removal/hiding. * Creating Facebook Engagement reports. * Understanding customer interests and demands to make proposals.

* Must have at least 1 year of practical experience in call center and Facebook page moderation.
* Priority will be given if experienced in Genex Infosys / Digicon Technology Ltd.
* Running students need not apply, must work in two shifts (mandatory).
* Must work in the office - not work from home.
* Must have a smart, polite, and humble demeanor, and avoid regionalism while speaking.
* Must have the mentality to speak with patience and interest with customers, giving importance to the customer's statements and providing solutions beautifully.
* Must be skilled in problem-solving.
* 1000 taka will be given for snacks every month.
* There is a good incentive for earning outside of salary.
* 4 days off per month and opportunity for overtime.
* Working hours: 9 am to 7 pm and 12 pm to 10 pm. (Must work in both shifts)
* Educational qualification: Minimum HSC.
* Age: 22 to 27 years.

Responsibilities: - Deliver grocery orders to customers promptly and accurately, confirming each delivery matches the order details.
- Greet clients with a friendly, respectful demeanor and maintain professional behavior during every interaction.
- Plan efficient routes and manage time effectively to meet scheduled delivery windows and minimize delays.
- Load, secure, and unload items carefully to prevent damage to perishable and fragile products.
- Verify orders at the point of delivery, collect signatures, and process payments or proof-of-delivery through the company system.
- Follow traffic laws, company safety procedures, and food-handling guidelines to protect customers and goods.
- Perform basic vehicle checks, maintain cleanliness of the delivery vehicle, and report mechanical issues promptly.
- Communicate clearly with dispatch and supervisors about delays, incidents, or special delivery instructions.
- Keep accurate records and update delivery statuses in the company app in a timely manner.
- Assist customers courteously with inquiries, returns, or missing items, escalating concerns when necessary.
- Represent the company positively by adhering to uniform, hygiene, and conduct standards.
- Participate in training and comply with local regulations and company policies related to delivery operations and safety.
